info.title: Thrust /api/v1
info.description: Plane's public v1 API as Thrust serves it. Compared with the pinned Plane schema by `oasdiff`.

get.summary:
`GET /workspaces/{slug}/{family}/search/`: the work items of the caller's own projects that a name, a project identifier or a
number says. Any key may ask (the pin's permission is only that the caller is authenticated): a caller who is in no project of the
workspace gets no work items, not a refusal.
get.description:
The pin's schema describes one hit as the whole answer (`IssueSearch`, with a `sequence_id` that is a string); what it answers is
`{"issues": [hit, ...]}` with a whole number (the oracle's corpus, `search`), which is what this document says.

get.summary:
`GET .../labels/`: the project's labels, newest first, paged. There is no `order_by` here (the pin's view orders by the URL's
keyword argument, which no route has), and `expand` is ignored (D-032). The pin's schema lists both as parameters, so the
document does (`ListQuery`): a request that sends them is answered as one that does not.

patch.summary:
`PATCH .../labels/{id}/`: change a label. The base view reads the body before the handler runs, so a body that cannot be parsed
is refused before the label is looked for; the handler then finds the label (an archived project has none to find), and only then
does the serializer read what the body says, so a list, or a field that is wrong, comes after the 404.

IssueDto.description:
The pin's `IssueSerializer`: 29 keys, all of them in every body. A work item that is read is live, so it is not a draft, not archived
and not deleted, and it has no estimate point and no type (D-033). A key whose value can be `null` is `Option`, which is what the
document says of it.

archived_at.description: Always `null`: a list is of work items that are not archived.

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted work item is not shown.

description_binary.description: Always `null`: the pin's binary form of the description is not kept.

is_draft.description: Always `false`: a draft is not shown.

sequence_id.description:
The project's running number ("PLATF-7" is 7). A bigint here; the pin's column is an int32, so its schema bounds it and this
one does not (the register says so).

type.description: Always `null`: there are no work item types.

IssueRequest.description:
What a work item's creation takes (the pin's `IssueSerializer` as a request): only `name` is required, and it cannot be blank. The
route reads every key the serializer has, and keeps the name, the description, the priority, the two dates, the state, the parent,
the point, the people, the labels and the integration key; the rest is read and checked and then not kept (D-033 (1)). `priority`
and the lists are not `null`; a date, a key and the relations can be.

IssueSearchDto.description:
What the workspace search answers: `{"issues": [...]}`. The pin's schema describes one hit as the whole answer; its recorded answers
are this (the oracle's corpus, `search`).

IssueSearchItemDto.description: One hit of the workspace search: the pin's `IssueSearch`, which its schema describes as the whole answer.

sequence_id.description: A whole number here and on the pin's wire (the oracle's corpus, `search`); the pin's schema says a string.

LabelCreateUpdateRequest.description:
What a label's creation takes (the pin's `LabelCreateUpdateSerializer`): only `name` is required, and `name` cannot be blank. `color`
and `description` can be blank and cannot be `null`; the two external keys and `parent` can be `null`.

LabelDto.description:
The pin's `LabelSerializer`: 15 keys, all of them in every body (a key whose value can be `null` is `Option`, which is what the
document says of it). A work item that is read with `expand=labels` carries this body too (`work_items::expansion`).

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted label is not shown.

parent.description: A live label of the same project, or none (D-032 (1)).

LabelRef.description: A label: its id, or with `expand=labels` the label as the label routes answer it.

type.description: Always `null`: there are no work item types.

Listing_IssueDto.description:
What a list answers: a page, or, when the request names an integration key (both halves), the one work item that has it. The pin's
schema describes only the page.

Page_IssueDto.description:
The 12-key envelope of every v1 list (`BasePaginator`): the page's rows, how many there are in all, how many pages, and the
cursors of the next and the previous page. The pin's schema has one per resource (`PaginatedProjectResponse`, ...), which differ
only in what `results` holds.

grouped_by.description: Always `null`: a v1 list is not grouped. The key is always there (`required`), whatever it holds.

Page_ProjectDto.description:
The 12-key envelope of every v1 list (`BasePaginator`): the page's rows, how many there are in all, how many pages, and the
cursors of the next and the previous page. The pin's schema has one per resource (`PaginatedProjectResponse`, ...), which differ

grouped_by.description: Always `null`: a v1 list is not grouped. The key is always there (`required`), whatever it holds.

items.description:
The pin's `ProjectSerializer`: 43 keys, and `sort_order` besides when the caller's place in the list is part of the answer. The pin
counts cycles and modules; Thrust has neither, so both are 0 (a deviation the register carries, D-030 (1)), and no deploy board
exists. A key whose value can be `null` here is `Option`, which is what the document says of it (the pin's schema calls some of
these non-nullable and sends `null` all the same: EX-006).

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted project is not shown.

sort_order.description:
Present in a list and absent from one project: the caller's place among the project's members, `null` for a person who has
none (the outer `Option` is whether the key is there, the inner one what it holds).

cursors of the next and the previous page. The pin's schema has one per resource (`PaginatedProjectResponse`, ...), which differ
only in what `results` holds.

grouped_by.description: Always `null`: a v1 list is not grouped. The key is always there (`required`), whatever it holds.

The 12-key envelope of every v1 list (`BasePaginator`): the page's rows, how many there are in all, how many pages, and the

grouped_by.description: Always `null`: a v1 list is not grouped. The key is always there (`required`), whatever it holds.

items.description:
The pin's `StateSerializer`: 18 keys. `is_triage` is whether the group is the intake's, which a state of the list never is (the pin
stores it apart from the group, and a request can set it on a state of another group: the register carries that). A key whose value
can be `null` here is `Option`, which is what the document says of it.

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted state is not shown.

slug.description:
The pin's `slugify` of the name ([`crate::states::slugify`]): it can be empty, for a name with no letter or digit that NFKD
leaves in ASCII, which is what the pin answers too.

PatchedIssueRequest.description: What a work item's change takes: the creation's keys, none required.

PatchedLabelCreateUpdateRequest.description: What a label's change takes: the creation's keys, none required.

PatchedProjectUpdateRequest.description:
What a project's change takes (the pin's `ProjectUpdateSerializer`): the creation's keys, none required, and the two ids that a
change can set.

PatchedStateRequest.description: What a state's change takes: the creation's keys, none required.

PriorityEnum.description:
The pin's `PriorityEnum`: the five priorities, as the pin writes them and in its order. The request descriptions use it too, so the
five names are written once.

ProjectCreateRequest.description:
What a project's creation takes (the pin's `ProjectCreateSerializer`). `description` and the two switches are optional and not
nullable; the ids and the texts that can be `null` are `Option`.

StateBriefDto.description: A state as `expand=state` shows it: the four keys the oracle's corpus has.

StateDto.description:
The pin's `StateSerializer`: 18 keys. `is_triage` is whether the group is the intake's, which a state of the list never is (the pin
stores it apart from the group, and a request can set it on a state of another group: the register carries that). A key whose value

deleted_at.description: Always `null`: a deleted state is not shown.

slug.description:

StateRef.description: A work item's state: its id, or with `expand=state` the state.

StateRequest.description:
What a state's creation takes (the pin's `StateSerializer` as a request): `name` and `color` are required, the rest is optional, and
only the two external keys can be `null`.

UserBriefDto.description: A person as `expand=assignees` shows them (the pin's `UserLiteSerializer`).

avatar_url.description: `null` for a person with no avatar.

UserRef.description: An assignee: the person's id, or with `expand=assignees` the person.
